svg.title: Soccolo, construction
svg.text: separation 85.88, exactly the width of two c's
stroke 20.40 at the flanks, 17.40 top and bottom
Every axis is measured off the typeface's own o.
The two forms never touch; the dot is structural.
set in Poppins SemiBold (SIL Open Font License 1.1)
the letter's own aperture is ±18.6°; the symbol opens to ±27.3° so the dot has room
the symbol is original artwork, not the typeface's c
outlines are supplied converted, so no font file ships with the mark
